_about: Hand-labelled facts, read off the source pages by a human before looking at
what the pipeline extracted. Spread across all six starter documents and
deliberately mixed in difficulty: headline stat blocks, dense financial
tables, prose with the number spelled inside a sentence, and one page whose
'value_text' is the number exactly as printed. 'canonical_value' is what the
normaliser should turn it into, in base units - that is a second, harder
assertion than merely finding the fact. 'period' is the canonical key
expected for the reporting period, on the Indian fiscal convention where a
year ending 31 March 2024 is FY2024; null where the fact is not periodic.
Recall over this set is the number that matters. It is small enough to be
honest about and large enough to be embarrassing.
